qualifier: postsynaptic membrane organization
name: Dendritic spine maintenance and postsynaptic membrane organization
rationale: All members regulate maintenance of dendritic spines or the postsynaptic membrane, which separates the theme from confusables centred on spine morphogenesis, synaptic plasticity, postsynaptic density structure or dendrite arborization.

qualifier: platelet activation
name: Platelet activation and cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: The members are platelet activation and cytoskeletal remodeling gene modules; the platelet activation component distinguishes the theme from confusables about fibronectin matrix, integrin, Rap1 or Rho-driven fibroblast adhesion.

qualifier: neurofascin and NrCAM (L1-family) adhesion
name: L1-family adhesion molecules clustering axonal sodium channels
rationale: Neurofascin and NrCAM interactions together with voltage-gated sodium channel clustering describe node/initial-segment organization, unlike confusables on axon regeneration, myelination or DSCAM/nectin heterophilic adhesion.

core: regulation of sodium and potassium transmembrane transport
qualifier: aldosterone and renal sodium handling
name: Regulation of sodium and potassium transmembrane transport
rationale: Members concern regulation of Na+ and K+ import/export and their aldosterone/renal control, which separates the theme from confusables about osmotic responses, chloride transport or glomerular filtration and blood volume.

qualifier: cholinergic and amino acid (GABA, glutamate, glycine), not monoamine
name: Cholinergic and amino acid neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine, GABA, glutamate/aspartate and glycine synthesis, SLC transport, nicotinic receptors and clostridial toxins blocking release, distinguishing the theme from the monoamine-rich confusable and from confusables lacking the cholinergic or amino acid transporter arms.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium uptake and relaxation
name: Cardiac sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling and relaxation
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium import and release, ATPase-coupled calcium transport, relaxation and contractile force in cardiac muscle, whereas confusables emphasize heart rate, sodium/calcium exchange or plasma membrane calcium flux.

qualifier: Tfh/ICOS help and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal center Tfh help and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover germinal center B cell and Tfh differentiation, ICOS co-stimulation and plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules, distinguishing the theme from confusables on naive/memory B cell signatures and B cell proliferation.

core: RNA virus genome replication and viral mRNA translation
qualifier: influenza, RSV and coronavirus
name: Influenza, RSV and coronavirus RNA replication and translation
rationale: Members describe genome replication, transcription, vRNP handling and host translation takeover by influenza, RSV and SARS coronaviruses, unlike confusables on HIV/HCMV DNA-stage events or translational frameshifting.

qualifier: BRCA1-PALB2-BRCA2 dependence and its defects
name: BRCA1-PALB2-BRCA2-dependent homologous recombination strand exchange
rationale: Members cover RAD51 presynaptic strand exchange, SDSA D-loop resolution and BRCA1/PALB2/BRCA2 loss-of-function defects, distinguishing the theme from confusables on end resection, SSA, MMEJ, NHEJ and DSB sensing.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycan chains plus O-mannose, O-fucose and O-glucose glycans, including congenital defects
name: Glycosaminoglycan and O-mannose, O-fucose, O-glucose glycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members build GAG chains (heparan, chondroitin, dermatan, keratan sulfate), dystroglycan O-mannose and Notch/TSR O-fucose/O-glucose glycans and their genetic defects, unlike confusables on GAG degradation, N-glycan/blood group synthesis or muscle development.

Members mix protein oligomerization, PRPP and fructose synthesis, creatine metabolism, mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, magnesium and inositol transport and calcium-independent adhesion with no shared biological process.

qualifier: lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation mesoderm migration, lateral plate and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover germ-layer formation, mesendoderm and mesodermal cell migration, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, whereas confusables focus on primitive streak, definitive endoderm, pluripotency or pericardium.

qualifier: STAT5 activation and CBL/SRC-kinase regulation
name: FLT3 and fusion kinase signaling to STAT5, CBL-regulated
rationale: Members describe wild-type, ITD and fusion FLT3 (and FGFR1 fusion) signaling through STAT5 and SRC kinases with CBL negative regulation, distinguishing the theme from TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants, EPO/TPO, interleukin and PDGFR mutant signaling.

qualifier: respiratory burst and degranulation
name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members regulate respiratory burst/superoxide generation, neutrophil degranulation and cytotoxic killing of bacteria and fungi, unlike confusables on macrophage phagocytes, neutrophil chemotaxis or metal-sequestering antimicrobial proteins.

qualifier: prefoldin delivery and actin/tubulin substrates
name: Prefoldin and TRiC/CCT chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: All members are TRiC/CCT chaperonin folding steps including prefoldin transfer and actin/tubulin folding, distinguishing the theme from general de novo folding, aggrephagy and G-protein beta folding confusables.

qualifier: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase in Golgi and lysosome
name: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase-driven Golgi and lysosome acidification
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase assembly, proton transport, carbonic anhydrase CO2 hydration and Golgi/lysosomal pH reduction, unlike confusables on lysosomal pH elevation, phospholipid scrambling, pigmentation or bicarbonate transport.

qualifier: autophosphorylation and ERK1/2 activation
name: Receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation and ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members share receptor tyrosine autophosphorylation, downstream signal transduction and ERK1/2 cascade activation, distinguishing the theme from PDGF-receptor regulation, PI3K/AKT and FGFR PLC/PI3K confusables.

qualifier: respiratory complex assembly and iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis
name: Respiratory chain assembly, oxidative phosphorylation and iron-sulfur clusters
rationale: Members cover electron transport, complex I/III/IV and ATP synthase assembly, chemiosmotic ATP synthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein import, cristae, proteolysis or heme synthesis.

qualifier: platelet formation within the erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage
name: Megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation, erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage
rationale: Members regulate megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet morphogenesis plus erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage modules, distinguishing the theme from confusables on erythrocyte maturation, RUNX1 regulation or myeloid progenitors.

qualifier: calcineurin-NFAT control of hypertrophy, atrophy and fiber type
name: Calcineurin-regulated striated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and fiber-type adaptation
rationale: Members regulate muscle hypertrophy, atrophy, cell size, fiber-type transition and responses to activity/inactivity with calcineurin-NFAT signaling, unlike confusables on cardiac contraction, neuronal calcium signaling or cardiomyocyte proliferation and regeneration.

qualifier: signal sequence recognition
name: Cotranslational signal sequence recognition and ER protein targeting
rationale: All members concern SRP-dependent cotranslational targeting of nascent proteins to the ER, distinguishing the theme from ribosome rescue/NMD, Golgi budding and COPI/COPII vesicle traffic confusables.

qualifier: splicing, 3'-end processing, snRNP biogenesis and mRNA export
name: Pre-mRNA splicing, 3'-end processing, snRNP biogenesis and nuclear export
rationale: Members cover spliceosome assembly and splicing, polyadenylation and histone mRNA processing, snRNA transcription/snRNP assembly and mature mRNA export, unlike confusables on cytoplasmic mRNA decay, rRNA processing and RNA polymerase I/III transcription.

core: adipocyte differentiation and lipid metabolic regulation
qualifier: nuclear receptor (PPAR, LXR, circadian) transcriptional control
name: Adipocyte differentiation and nuclear receptor control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover white/brown/beige adipogenesis and PPAR, LXR, SREBP, PGC-1alpha and ROR/REV-ERB control of triglyceride, fatty acid and glucose metabolism, distinguishing the theme from ChREBP glucose sensing, lipid droplet turnover and thermogenesis confusables.

qualifier: calcineurin signaling and cardiomyocyte proliferation
name: Calcineurin-regulated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: Members regulate muscle hypertrophy, atrophy, cell size and calcineurin-NFAT signaling together with cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and regeneration, unlike confusables on myoblast myogenesis or sarcomere contraction.

qualifier: error-prone, by POLK, POLI and REV1
name: Error-prone translesion synthesis by POLK, POLI and REV1
rationale: Members describe PCNA-mediated damage recognition, error-prone bypass by POLK, POLI and REV1 and its termination, distinguishing the theme from POLH error-free TLS, base excision gap filling and replicative synthesis confusables.
